contactSection.title: Still Have Questions?
contactSection.description: Can't find what you're looking for? Our support team is here to help.

questions.a: Processing and shipping usually take around 7–28 business days depending on your region. Orders to South Africa and some African countries may take longer.
Yes! Once your order has been shipped for import and cleared through customs in your country, the tracking number will be sent to your email.

questions.q: Do I need to pay import taxes?
questions.a: Yes. Import taxes and customs fees depend on your country’s regulations and must be paid by the recipient.
Yes, our press-on nails can be reused if they are removed and stored carefully.

questions.q: Do you offer custom nail designs?
questions.a: Yes! We accept custom press-on nail designs based on your ideas or reference images.

questions.q: What is included in each set?
questions.a: Each order includes 10 designed nails, adhesive tabs, nail glue, a mini nail file, and a cuticle stick.

questions.q: How do I choose the correct nail size?
questions.a: Please measure your nails carefully according to our size guide before placing an order.

questions.q: What if I choose the wrong size?
questions.a: We are not responsible for incorrect sizes provided by customers.

questions.q: Do you offer refunds or exchanges?
questions.a: No. Since all nail sets are handmade to order, we do not accept refunds, exchanges, cancellations, or product changes.

questions.q: How can I contact the shop?
questions.a: You can contact us via Instagram @silver14nail or by email at silver14nail@gmail.com.
